satirlar.metin: Five money mistakes could be keeping you broke, and number one catches almost everyone. Let's count down!
Number five: spending without a plan. If you never track your money, it often disappears.
Number four: forgotten subscriptions. Small monthly charges can quietly add up.
Number three: no emergency savings. One surprise bill can then turn into debt.
Number two: high-interest debt. Interest can make a balance grow faster than you expect.
And number one: lifestyle inflation. Many people spend more every time they earn more.
Which mistake have you made? Comment below, and subscribe!
